Dear Tanja,
The charger was stuck in the converter grouping stage. I have forced the configuration to fixed however the charger received a reboot command from the backend.
After rebooting, the charger is again operational and all outlets are available.
I will proceed to close this ticket since the issue is fixed.
I attach Semih in CC just for his information since you have asked to address the ticket to him.
